text:
Suresh: Backporting Starlite customer's LoRA merge to the 7B int4 runtime build (stable-quant-v2). Quick eval pack shows token-level numeric drift on invoice numbers. Rolling issue in smoke tests. Anyone free to triage? cc @lina @ana

Lina: On it. Can you paste the eval log + config?

Suresh: Pasting the short repro and results. Quickpack eval (100 samples) -> BLEU-ish metric drop ~6% vs baseline; specific failure mode: amounts get truncated e.g., 'USD 1,200' -> 'USD 120'.

Suresh: ```bash
# run local quickpack
./tools/run_quick_eval.sh --model starlite-lora-merged --quant int4 --eval-pack quickpack-invoice --seed 42
```

Suresh: excerpt of the failing output: "Please confirm payment: 120 USD" expected "Please confirm payment: 1,200 USD"

Lina: Hmm can you share the model merge method? Did we use weight-merge vs additive-stitch?

Suresh: used additive-stitch with per-layer alpha=0.7 (stitch config attached).

Suresh: ```json
{"merge_method":"additive-stitch","alpha":0.7,"fuse_layernorm":true}
```

Ana: My guess: quantization bias interacting with scale factors on the adapter output. Try re-running with per-channel scale and/or disabling fused_ln in runtime. Also try disabling KV prefix cache in serving to replicate.

QA Bot: regression-alert: https://internal.redwood/alerts/ALRT-2026-197 — regression triggered on quickpack-invoice (crt 2026-03-19 16:12Z)

Sam: Repro'd locally — if I re-run with --kv-cache=off the numeric drop disappears. Quick test results: baseline=correct, merged+int4+kvcache=bad, merged+int4+kvcache=off good. Command I used:

Sam: ```bash
./tools/run_quick_eval.sh --model starlite-lora-merged --quant int4 --eval-pack quickpack-invoice --kv-cache off
```

Sam: So likely a KV cache rounding/offset bug w/ merged weights. Lina can you try a patch that forces float32 accumulation in KV cache writepath?

Lina: Yep. I'll run a microbench and put a patch up. If fix is nontrivial, fallback plan: pin customer to int8-stable or disable kv-cache in Dedicated policy for this customer.

Suresh: Thanks. Action items: Lina to PR patch (owner), Sam to run extended eval (1k samples) with KV off, Ana to coordinate rollback policy with CS if needed.

Lina: PR opened: https://git.redwood/r/runtime/pulls/3142 (WIP). Patch forces float32 accumulation and adds unit test for numeric-preservation in kv write.

Sam: Extended eval (1k samples) run finished — no divergence with KV off. Metrics attached (https://internal.redwood/artifacts/quickpack-1k-starlite)

Suresh: Good. If patch passes internal review we'll schedule a canary backfill on staging tomorrow 09:00 PT and then customer rollout with opt-in. :thumbsup:

Lina: I'll follow up with a short changelog + QA checklist once tests pass. :white_check_mark:
